scientific_role: M2 preserves inverse ambiguity under the frozen public I1 by carrying a small deliberately diverse portfolio of independently confirmed provider surrogates through native graph composition, and reports both an equal-weight ensemble central prediction and a finite-portfolio ambiguity range.

relationship_to_m1.M1: Collapse each provider inverse problem to one fitted surrogate theta_i and return one graph-sigma prediction.
relationship_to_m1.M2: Retain three deliberately diverse, independently confirmed I1-compatible surrogates per provider and propagate their joint combinations.

provider_portfolios.source: frozen M2-A4 independently confirmed diverse portfolios
provider_portfolios.selection_principle: Every member must satisfy the already-frozen public-I1 compatibility/confirmation gate; among compatible members the A4 portfolio is deliberately diverse in latent parameter space.
provider_portfolios.probabilistic_interpretation: The A4 portfolios are diversity-selected representatives, not iid draws or posterior samples.

joint_graph_portfolio.construction: Cartesian product of the three frozen provider portfolios.
joint_graph_portfolio.formula: P_G = P_A x P_B x P_C
joint_graph_portfolio.role_of_existing_M2_B3: Retained as a diagnostic sensitivity stage showing how one-provider-at-a-time inverse ambiguity propagates and which provider dominates; it is not the final operational M2 ensemble.

weighting.interpretation: Principle-of-indifference ensemble convention over the deliberately diverse frozen representatives. The equal-weight mean is an ensemble central estimate, not a Bayesian posterior expectation and not an estimate of natural parameter-space frequency.

ensemble_mean.interpretation: Equal-weight central prediction across the 27 frozen joint portfolio members.

ambiguity_range.interpretation: Finite-portfolio ambiguity range induced by the frozen diverse M2 representatives. It is not a statistical confidence interval and is not claimed to be the exact global range over every I1-compatible latent model.

secondary_outputs: portfolio quantiles for descriptive diagnostics only
identities of pointwise minimum and maximum joint combinations

current_pilot_graph_semantics.reason: A_G is held fixed across M1, M2 members, and white-box evaluation to isolate graph-sigma integration error from admissibility-region mismatch.

uncertainty_separation.monte_carlo_uncertainty: Finite-trajectory uncertainty in each empirical sigma_G estimate.
uncertainty_separation.rule: Do not interpret the M2 min-max portfolio range as a confidence interval. If Monte Carlo bands are reported, compute and display them separately.

evaluation_metrics.admissibility_region: D_A/Jaccard is N/A in the current same-region experiment.

whitebox_discipline.reason: G0 white-box results were already inspected before this semantic freeze.
whitebox_discipline.fresh_validation_requirement: The frozen M2 semantics must be evaluated unchanged on at least one untouched graph, workload, admissibility regime, or other predeclared white-box condition before a strong prospective validation claim.
whitebox_discipline.posthoc_best_member: ProviderC_LHS_038 remains a useful diagnostic showing that a highly accurate graph explanation existed inside the composition-blind compatible set, but it is not the operational M2 prediction.

cost_semantics.build_cost: Existing M2-A2/A3/A4 portfolio-discovery and confirmation cost is part of M2 build cost.
cost_semantics.query_cost: Native graph propagation over the 27 frozen joint combinations plus aggregation.
cost_semantics.update_cost: Not defined for frozen M2; dynamic updates belong to a later method.

non_goals: Do not interpret equal weights as posterior probabilities.
Do not weight members by local reconstruction loss in frozen M2.
Do not select a single M2 member using graph white-box accuracy.
Do not change I1 or expose additional provider information.
Do not rerun or replace the frozen A4 portfolio merely to improve G0.
Do not call the finite-portfolio min-max range a confidence interval.

implementation_handoff.required_behavior: Enumerate all 27 frozen A4 joint combinations, simulate them with one fresh common-random-number graph seed bank, aggregate equal-weight mean and finite-portfolio min-max range before graph white-box evaluation.
implementation_handoff.exact_seed_bank: to be frozen in the B5 execution contract
